pages.title: Dragons Plus Fan Effects
pages.text: Create: Dragons Plus adds new things for a [#](2E5AAC)[Fan](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() to do. Blow air through a catalyst and items in the stream get processed in bulk.

**Freezing** (Powder Snow): ice to packed ice to blue ice, magma cream to slime ball, blaze rod to breeze rod.

**Ending** (Dragon Head or Dragon's Breath): cobblestone to end stone, apple to chorus fruit, leather to phantom membrane.

pages.title: Dragon's Breath
pages.text: A real fluid, usable in cauldrons. It turns to End Stone where it meets lava.
**Coloring**: Liquid Dye, made by mixing a dye with water, colors items, mobs and armor it touches. Fans blowing through it color items in bulk. Dye meeting lava makes matching concrete.

**Sanding** (quicksand) does sandpaper recipes in bulk. **Enchanting** (Golden Aercloud) runs Aether Altar recipes and incubates Moa Eggs. See [#](2E5AAC)[Dimensions](entry://exploration/dimensions)[#]().

pages.title: Fragile Fluid Tank
pages.text: Breaks on impact and splashes its fluid onto the surroundings. Fluid Hatches let tanks be filled and emptied by hand.
Create Connected has matching fan catalyst blocks. See [#](2E5AAC)[Building with Create](entry://home/create_decor)[#]().
